detail_list.name: Aegagropila linnaei
detail_list.introduction: Cladophora aegagropila is not really a plant, but a ball of algae from 3-10 cm wide. It is a decorative exception from the rule about avoiding algae at all costs. It is normally found in shallow lakes, where the movement of the waves forms it into a sphere. In an aquarium it must be turned regularly to keep it in shape. Cladophora aegagrophila can be divided into smaller pieces, which become spherical with time, or which form a carpet, if attached to roots and stones. Protected in parts of Japan.
detail_list.introduction_cn: Cladophora aegagropila 并不是真正的水草，而是直径约 3-10 厘米的球状藻体。水波推动会使它逐渐形成球形；放入水族箱后需定期翻面，才能保持形状。它也可以分成小块，之后重新长成球状，或固定在沉木和石材上铺展开来。日本部分地区对其实施保护。

detail_list.name: Alternanthera reineckii 'Mini'
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. This miniature version of the well-known Alternanthera is characterized by compact growth and a slower growth rate. It is particularly suitable for small aquariums or as a foreground plant in larger aquascapes. By careful trimming, it is possible to create a dense, red violet carpet of approximately 5 to 10 cm height. High light intensity and addition of CO2 improves the plants growth and overall appearance.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 迷你血心兰采用密封杯组织培养，是常见血心兰的小型品种。它株型紧凑、生长较慢，适合小型水族箱，也可在大型造景中作前景草。通过定期修剪可形成约 5-10 厘米高的红紫色草坪。较强光照并补充 CO₂，有助于水草生长和发色。

detail_list.name: Alternanthera reineckii 'Pink'
detail_list.introduction: Plant in 5 cm pot. The pink underside of the leaves of Alternanthera reineckii 'Pink' provides an effective contrast to the many green plants in an aquarium - particularly when planted in groups. Stems becomes 25-50 cm tall. Good light encourages the leaves to turn red. Easy to propagate by nipping off the terminal bud and planting it in the substrate. This also makes the mother plant more bushy, because more side shoots are formed. Alternanthera reineckii 'Pink' originated in South America.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 粉红血心兰是一种种植在5 厘米盆中的水草。其叶子的粉红色背面与水族箱中的许多绿色植物形成有效对比，特别是在成群种植时。茎可长至25-50 厘米高。充足的光照可促使叶子变红。通过剪下顶端芽并将其植入底床进行扦插繁殖，繁殖十分容易。这也使得母株更加茂密，因为会产生更多的侧芽。粉红血心兰原产于南美洲。

detail_list.name: Alternanthera reineckii 'Rosanervig'
detail_list.introduction: Vibrant pink leaves with light nerves characterise this vigorous culture form. The plant has a compact form of growth and the stalk does not grow as strong as other Alternanthera. Suitable for planting in the mid-section of the aquarium – and even in the front when cut well. As for all Alternanthera, good light and fertilizer conditions, as well as CO2 additive is material for growth and colour development.

detail_list.name: Ammannia crassicaulis
detail_list.introduction: Ammannia crassicaulis from Africa is a beautiful and highly recommended aquarium plant, although it has high light demands. It has red-brown, cognac-coloured leaves. Stems becomes 30-50 cm and 8-15 cm wide. Grows best in soft and slightly acidic water. Make sure the lower leaves get sufficient light or they will die off. In the aquarium it can be recognized by its yellow-green stems. Easy to propagate by side shoots or cuttings which you replant in the bottom.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 粗茎水苋原产于非洲，是一种美丽且推荐的水草，尽管它需要较高的光照。其叶片呈红棕色，带有白兰地色。茎的长度可达30-50 厘米，宽度为8-15 厘米。它在软水和略带酸性的水中生长最佳。确保下部叶片获得足够的光照，否则它们会枯死。在水族箱中，它可以通过其黄绿色的茎来识别。粗茎水苋可以通过侧芽或剪枝进行繁殖，将这些侧芽或剪枝重新植入底床即可。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri ’Coin Leaf’
detail_list.introduction: Anubias 'Coin Leaf' is a captivating cultivar of Anubias barteri. With its nearly circular leaves, measuring 4-6 cm in diameter, and a rich deep green color, this variant stands out. Its growth is slow and creeping, making it an ideal choice for aquarists seeking low-maintenance plants. Thriving in relatively low light, Anubias 'Coin Leaf' is an easy-to-grow plant that adds a touch of elegance to any aquarium. It can be placed on rocks or wood within the tank, but if planted in the substrate, take care not to bury the rhizome. Burying the rhizome can lead to rotting and the plant's demise. Discover the beauty of Anubias 'Coin Leaf' as it enhances your aquatic garden with its circular leaves and vibrant green hue.

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri 'Mini Coin'
detail_list.introduction: Anubias 'Mini Coin' is a variety of Anubias barteri found at the aquarium nursery Tropica in Denmark. The plant is among the very smallest Anubias, each leaf smaller than a little fingernail. It is as easy to grow as its parent, and so does not like bright light. Anubias 'Mini Coin' thrives best attached to rocks and tree roots in the aquarium. If planted in the substrate, the creeping stem (rhizome) must not be covered as this can cause the plant to rot and die. Anubias 'Mini Coin' branches readily and will form a dense cushion of small, round, deep green leaves. If the plant becomes too dense, it can be carefully divided and the new plants placed elsewhere in the aquarium. It is ideal for use in nano aquariums, but can also add to the small details of a larger aquarium

It is not very difficult to cultivate if you provide enough light and CO2. For aquascaping purposes, this Indian beauty mixes very well with red or brown-hued plants. It grows at moderate speed. Feel free to radically prune a group of plants - the stems will soon produce new side shoots, and your plants will be thicker.

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri nana
detail_list.introduction: Live aquatic plant in pot, packed in a breathable blister packaging to go. Anubias barteri var. nana is a small, attractive plant which thrives in all conditions. It originates from Cameroon and will reach 5-10 cm height. The rhizome will be 10-15 cm or more. It grows slowly, and the leaves survive for several years, giving slow-growing algae the chance to become established. The best result is achieved by planting on a stone or tree root. Fishing line can be used to attach the plant until it gains a hold. If planted on the bottom the rhizome must not be covered because it tends to rot. It flowers frequently under water. It is not eaten by herbivorous fish.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 盆栽水草，采用透气吸塑包装。小水榕是一种小型且美观的水草，适应各种环境。它原产于喀麦隆，可长至5-10 厘米高。其根茎长度可达10-15 厘米或更长。小水榕生长缓慢，叶片可存活数年，给缓慢生长的藻类提供了栖息机会。最佳效果是将它种植在石材或沉木上。可以使用鱼线将植物固定，直到其稳固。若将其种植在底床，则根茎不可被覆盖，否则容易腐烂。它在水中会频繁开花，并且不会被食草鱼食用。

detail_list.introduction_cn: 小水榕是一种小型美观的水草，适应各种环境。原产于喀麦隆，高度可达5-10 厘米。根茎长度可达10-15 厘米或更长。生长缓慢，叶片可以存活数年，给缓慢生长的藻类提供栖息机会。最佳效果是将其种植在带有吸盘的沉木或沉木上。可以使用鱼线将水草暂时固定，直到其牢固附着。如果将根茎种植在底床，则不能被覆盖，否则容易腐烂。它在水中会频繁开花，不会被食草鱼食用。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri 'Petite'
detail_list.introduction: Anubias sp. ‘Petite’ is a mutation which appeared in cultivation at the Oriental aquarium plant nursery in Singapore. Stays less than 5 cm tall, has very small leaves and a rhizome of 5-10 cm or more from which the leaves will grow. Branches well and creates dense groups. Undemanding like the other Anubias and does not appreciate high light intensity either. It is most decorative when attached to stones or roots, and like other Anubias it should be attached with fishing line until it gains a hold. If planted in the bottom, do not cover the rhizome as this may cause the plant to rot and die. An ideal plant for miniature landscapes in small aquariums but will also attract attention in larger tanks.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 袖珍小榕（Anubias sp. 'Petite'）是在新加坡东方水草苗圃中培育过程中出现的变异品种。植株高度不超过5 厘米，叶片非常小，根茎长度可达5-10 厘米或更长，叶片从根茎上生长出来。分枝能力强，能形成密集的群体。和其他 Anubias 品种一样，它对环境要求不高，也不喜欢强烈的光照。将它固定在石材或沉木上最为美观，和其他 Anubias 一样，需要用钓鱼线将其固定，直到它稳固地附着。如果将其种植在底床，不要覆盖根茎，否则可能会导致植株腐烂死亡。它适合小型水族箱中的微型景观，但在大型水族箱中也能吸引注意。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri sp.
detail_list.introduction: Large mangrove wood with rooted Anubias. Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia originates from an Australian tissue propagation laboratory. It is a very beautiful variety with heart-shaped leaves. The leaves live for several years, so Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia can easily form large groups despite its slow growth. A group of Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia growing more than 50 cm wide in a few years is not unusual.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 卡拉迪榕是一种水榕属的水草，源自澳大利亚的组织培养实验室。它是一种观赏性较强的品种，拥有心形叶片。这些叶片可以存活数年，因此尽管生长速度较慢，卡拉迪榕也能轻松形成大型群体。几年内，一个超过50 厘米宽的卡拉迪榕群体并不罕见。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri var. barteri
detail_list.introduction: Anubias barteri var. barteri from West Africa is an undemanding plant. It grows somewhat larger than Anubias barteri var. nana but is grown in the same conditions. From 25-45 cm tall and the creeping rhizome from 10-15 cm or more. Anubias barteri varies considerably in terms of size and leaf shape. Like other Anubias-species, it is best planted in a shady spot to minimize algae growth on the leaves. If planted on the bottom, the rhizome must not be covered because it tends to rot. It is also suitable for terrariums and paludariums. Herbivorous fish do not eat the very tough and robust leaves.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 大水榕来自西非，是一种易于养护的水草。它的植株比小水榕稍大，但养护条件相同。植株高度在25-45 厘米之间，根茎长度可达10-15 厘米或更长。Anubias barteri 的大小和叶片形状变化较大。和其他水榕属种类一样，最好将其种植在阴暗的位置以减少叶片上的藻类生长。如果将根茎埋在底床中，容易腐烂，因此根茎部分不能被覆盖。它也适合种植在雨林缸和沼泽缸中。由于叶片非常坚韧，食草性鱼类不会啃食。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia
detail_list.introduction: Large motherplant, grown in a 9 cm square pot. Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia originates from an Australian tissue propagation laboratory. It is a very beautiful variety with heart-shaped leaves. The leaves live for several years, so Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia can easily form large groups despite its slow growth. A group of Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia growing more than 50 cm wide in a few years is not unusual.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 大型母株，种植在 9 厘米方盆中。卡拉迪榕来源于澳大利亚组织培养实验室。这是一种观赏性较强的品种，拥有心形叶片。叶片可以存活数年，因此尽管卡拉迪榕生长缓慢，也能轻松形成大型群体。几年内，一个超过50 厘米宽的群体并不罕见。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri var. 'Coffeifolia'
detail_list.introduction: Anubias barteri var. coffeifolia is a very beautiful, low cultivar of Anubias barteri. 15-25 cm tall and a creeping rhizome from 10-15 cm or more. It is characteristic that the leaves arch considerably between the leaf ribs, and the new leaves are red-brown. The colour combination and leaf shape make it an attractive variety in both large and small aquariums. It flowers frequently under water but does not produce seeds there. Anubias species seem to grow so slowly that they do not realize that they have been submerged. It is not eaten by herbivorous fish.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 咖啡榕是 Anubias barteri 的矮生栽培品种，株高约 15-25 厘米，匍匐根茎长约 10-15 厘米或更长。叶片在叶脉之间明显隆起，新叶呈红褐色，独特的叶形和色彩适合大小不同的水族箱。它常在水下开花，但不会在水下结籽。和其他水榕一样，咖啡榕生长非常缓慢，也不容易被食草鱼啃食。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri var. glabra
detail_list.introduction: Anubias barteri var. glabra from West Africa is a beautiful plant with long, narrow leaves. 10-20 cm tall with a rhizome, from which the leaves develop, that grows 10-15 cm or larger. Very easy to grow since it thrives in almost any conditions, although high light intensity should be avoided. Place it instead in shady positions under larger plants. If planted in the bottom, do not cover the rhizome, it tends to rot. It is not eaten by herbivorous fish. Anubias barteri var. glabra used to be sold as Anubias afzelii, but the latter is actually a much larger species.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 格拉布拉水榕来自西非，是一种拥有长而窄叶子的美丽水草。植株高度可达10-20 厘米，根茎长度为10-15 厘米或更大，叶子从根茎上生长出来。这种水草非常容易养护，几乎适应任何条件，但应避免强光照射，最好将其置于大型植物下的阴暗位置。如果将其种植在底床，不要覆盖根茎，否则容易腐烂。格拉布拉水榕不会被食草鱼吃掉。格拉布拉水榕过去常被误认为是 Anubias afzelii，但实际上后者是一种植株更大的物种。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri var. nana
detail_list.introduction: Anubias barteri var. nana is a small, attractive plant that thrives in all conditions. It originates from Cameroon and will reach 5-10 cm height. The rhizome will be 10-15 cm or more. It grows slowly, and the leaves survive for several years, giving slow-growing algae the chance to become established. The best result is achieved by planting on a stone or tree root. Fishing line can be used to attach the plant until it gains a hold. If planted on the bottom the rhizome must not be covered because it tends to rot. It flowers frequently under water and will thrive in shady places, where other plants will not. It is not eaten by herbivorous fish.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 小水榕是一种适应性强的小型水草，原产于喀麦隆，高度可达5-10 厘米。其根茎长度可达10-15 厘米或更长。小水榕生长缓慢，叶片可以存活数年，给藻类提供了生长机会。最佳的种植方式是将其固定在石材或沉木上。可以使用鱼线暂时固定植株，直到其稳固。若将其种植在底床，根茎必须露出，否则容易腐烂。它在水下会频繁开花，并且在其他植物难以生长的阴暗环境中也能生长良好。小水榕不会被食草鱼食用。

detail_list.introduction: Coconuts are becoming increasingly popular amongst aquarium enthusiasts both for their practicality and aesthetics. detail_list.introduction_cn: 椰壳在水族箱爱好者中越来越受欢迎，既实用又美观。小水榕是一种最容易种植的水草，因此我们将其与可持续椰壳搭配使用。小水榕原产于喀麦隆，高度可达5-10 厘米。根茎长度可达10-15 厘米或更长。它生长缓慢，叶子可以存活数年。在水中会频繁开花。不会被食草鱼吃掉。小水榕是一种小型且美观的水草，适应所有环境。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri var. nana ’Kirin’
detail_list.introduction: Anubias barteri 'Kirin' is a captivating aquatic cultivar inspired by an Asian dragon. Its ovate dark green leaves with strongly wavy edges, measuring 3-4 cm, set it apart from other Anubias species. This slow-growing plant thrives in low-light conditions and is best attached to wood or rock in the aquarium. Avoid covering the rhizome to prevent rot and ensure its survival. Experience the magic of Anubias barteri 'Kirin' as it adds a touch of enchantment to your aquascape.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 麒麟小榕是水榕的栽培品种，深绿色卵形叶片长约 3-4 厘米，叶缘有明显波浪。它生长缓慢，适应弱光，适合固定在沉木或石材上。种入底床时不要埋住根茎，以免腐烂。

detail_list.name: Anubias barteri var. nana ’Pinto’
detail_list.introduction: Anubias 'Pinto' is an exquisite selected cultivar of Anubias barteri. Its leaves, measuring 3-6 cm, showcase captivating patterns of white, light green, and dark green. These patterns can vary depending on the environment, and under certain conditions, the plant may develop entirely dark green leaves. Achieving the perfect balance of light is crucial as good lighting enhances the white patterns, but excessive light can lead to damage and algae issues. With slow growth, Anubias 'Pinto' is a plant that demands patience. It can be beautifully incorporated into aquascapes by attaching it to rocks or wood in the aquarium. However, it is essential to remember never to cover the rhizome, as this can result in rotting and the plant's demise. Unveil the enchanting allure of Anubias 'Pinto' as it adorns your aquascape with its captivating blend of colors and intricate leaf patterns. Strike the perfect balance of lighting, and watch as this cultivar flourishes, becoming the centerpiece of your aquatic paradise.

detail_list.name: Anubias gracilis
detail_list.introduction: Western Africa is home to several species of Anubias, including this one. The triangular leaves of 5-10 cm on long leaf-stems make Anubias gracilis one of the most elegant. It is hardy and tolerant, a very good beginner’s plant. The plant can grow on rock or wood or planted on the bottom. If planted in the bottom, the rhizome, from which leaves and roots appear, must not be covered. If it is, the whole plant will rot and die. Anubias gracilis can be allowed to grow out of the water, but will attain a significant size this way.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 西非是水榕属的几种水草的原产地，包括这一种。三角榕的叶片呈三角形，叶柄长达5-10 厘米，使其成为最为优雅的水榕属之一。它非常耐受，适合初学者。这种水草可以附着在石材或沉木上生长，也可以直接种植在底床上。如果种植在底床上，其根茎必须露出，不能被覆盖，否则整个植株会腐烂死亡。三角榕也可以生长在水面以上，但这样植株会变得很大。

detail_list.name: Aponogeton boivinianus
detail_list.introduction: Aponogeton boivinianus is a large, strong plant which is only suitable for large aquariums. A bulb plant from Madagascar, whose bulb may be covered with the bottom layer, as long as the sprout tip is at the soil surface. In favourable conditions it can form very large leaves (up to 80 cm long and 8 cm wide, and from 30-50 cm wide). The oldest leaves are deep dark-green, while younger leaves are light-green and sometimes brownish until they are fully developed. Nutrition capsules enhances the growth considerably. In the wild, Aponogeton boivinianus is found in fast-flowing water, and it prefers some flow in the aquarium water. It needs a dormant period when the bulb loses all its leaves, after which the growth will start again.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 气泡草是一种大型强健的水草，仅适合大型水族箱。它是来自马达加斯加的球有茎草，球茎可以埋入底床，只要芽尖露出土壤表面即可。在适宜条件下，它可以长出非常大的叶子（最长可达80 厘米，宽达8 厘米，叶宽30-50 厘米）。最老的叶子呈深绿色，而新生的叶子则为浅绿色，有时会带有棕色，直到完全成熟。营养胶囊可以显著促进其生长。在野外，气泡草生长在水流湍急的环境中，因此在水族箱中也需要一定的水流。它需要一个休眠期，此时球茎会失去所有叶子，之后新的生长才会开始。

detail_list.name: Aponogeton longiplumulosus
detail_list.introduction: Aponogeton longiplumulosus from Madagascar has large, fluted leaves (35-60 cm long), making it a wonderful plant which can be recommended for large aquariums (the whole plant becomes 25-40 cm wide). The bulb can be covered with the bottom layer, as long as the sprout tip is at the soil surface. It is relatively undemanding and makes no special demands on water quality. A Nutrition capsule placed under the bulb enhances the growth considerably. It also flowers frequently, making it a beautiful addition to any large open aquarium. It stops growing at regular intervals, but normally starts again after a few weeks of dormancy.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 大卷浪草来自马达加斯加，拥有大型波纹叶（长35-60 厘米），适合大型水族箱（整株宽度可达25-40 厘米）。其球茎可以埋入底床，但芽尖需露出表面。该水草需求不高，对水质没有特殊要求。在球茎下方放置营养胶囊可以显著促进其生长。它经常开花，是大型开放水族箱中的美丽点缀。它会定期停止生长，但通常在几周休眠后会重新开始生长。

detail_list.name: Aponogeton madagascariensis
detail_list.introduction: Aponogeton madagascariensis is a bulb plant from Madagascar and is a speciality in botanical gardens all over the world. The bulb can be covered with the bottom layer, as long as the sprout tip is at the soil surface. Aponogeton madagascariensis makes such high demands on water quality and the bottom that it can only be recommended as a solitary plant in large, specialised aquariums in which the water is replaced frequently. Nutrition capsules enhances the growth considerably. There are several varieties, with different structures and leaf widths, and sizes from 25-50 cm.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 网草是一种来自马达加斯加的球有茎草，在世界各地的植物园中都是一种特别的植物。球茎可以埋入底床，只要芽尖露出土面即可。网草对水质和底床的要求很高，只能推荐在大型、专门化的水族箱中作为单株植物养殖，并且需要频繁更换水。营养胶囊可以显著促进其生长。有几种不同结构和叶片宽度的品种，植株高度在25-50 厘米之间。

detail_list.name: Aponogeton ulvaceus
detail_list.introduction: Aponogeton ulvaceus is one of the most beautiful bulb species in the Aponogeton-family and originates from Madagascar. The leaves are delicate light-green and transparent with fluted margin. A single root can produce more than 40 leaves, 30-60 cm long. This means that the plant is best as a solitary plant in large aquariums (the plant becomes up to 50 cm wide). It is relatively tolerant, and thrives in both soft and hard water, particularly if CO2 is added. There are many varieties of Aponogeton ulvaceus, some of which need a dormant period, when the root does not produce leaves.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 大浪草是水蕹属家族中最球茎类水草之一，原产于马达加斯加。其叶片呈淡绿色且透明，边缘有波纹。一根根茎可以长出超过40片叶子，每片叶子长度可达30-60 厘米。这意味着该植物最适合单独种植在大型水族箱中（植株宽度可达50 厘米）。大浪草相对耐受性强，能在软水和硬水中良好生长，尤其在添加 CO₂的情况下生长更佳。大浪草有多个品种，其中一些品种需要休眠期，在休眠期内根茎不会长出新叶。

detail_list.name: Bacopa australis
detail_list.introduction: Bacopa australis was discovered in southern Brazil (australis = southern), and it is not from Australia, as might otherwise be assumed from its name. Stems become 10-30 cm tall and 2-4 cm wide. Like the other Bacopa species, Bacopa australis is also easy to grow in an aquarium. Under certain conditions it creeps across the bottom to form an elegant and decorative light green cushion. When Bacopa australis grows in a good light, the leaves become reddish. It is easily propagated by taking side shoots and planting them in the substrate.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 澳洲虎耳在南巴西（australis 意为南部）被发现，其名字中的“澳洲”并非指澳大利亚。茎可长至10-30 厘米高，2-4 厘米宽。和其他 Bacopa 物种一样，澳洲虎耳在水族箱中也容易生长。在一定条件下，它会匍匐在底部形成优雅的浅绿色垫状。在充足光照下，叶子会变成红色。通过剪取侧枝并种植在底床中，可以轻松繁殖澳洲虎耳。

detail_list.name: Bacopa caroliniana
detail_list.introduction: Bacopa caroliniana originates from US and has been used as an aquarium plant for many years. Stems become 10-30 cm long and 3-4 cm wide, branching willingly from the bottom. It has few demands and thus very convenient for beginners. Its slow growth rate makes it one of the few stem plants that do not need much attention. Like most stem plants, it is most decorative when planted in small groups. Easy to propagate by cuttings, take a side shoot and plant it in the bottom. A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. Regarding stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2“). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance into the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant start growing.

detail_list.name: Bacopa monnieri 'Compact'
detail_list.introduction: This culture form of the stalk plant Bacopa Monnieri is more compact and, under good light conditions, almost a creeping plant. By pinching off all vertical growing shoots, the plant can maintain a low and close growth, since it willingly creates a large number of side shoots.Furthermore, the plant grows well in the shadow of other plants. Very suitable as a bit higher carpet – or bushy plant in the middle or front of the aquarium. The plant becomes more vertical growing and less compact without CO2 additive and decreased light conditions.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 迷你小对叶是 Bacopa monnieri 的紧凑型栽培品种，光照良好时株型接近匍匐。剪去向上直立生长的枝条，可促使它长出更多侧枝，保持低矮紧凑；它在其他水草的阴影下也能生长。适合用作稍高的铺地草，或种在中景、前景。不补充 CO₂ 或光照较弱时，植株会更直立，株型也会变得松散。

detail_list.name: Bacopa salzmannii 'Purple'
detail_list.introduction: Bacopa Salzmannii 'Purple' is a stunning aquatic plant that adds an exotic touch with its vibrant purple and green tones. Ideal for aquascapers, this plant is a favorite for creating striking color contrasts in the aquarium. Native to South American wetlands, it thrives in medium to high lighting, which intensifies its purple hues, making it an excellent midground or background choice. This hardy plant is relatively low maintenance, suited to aquarists of all levels. For best results, provide nutrient-rich substrate, regular fertilization, and consider CO2 addition to maximize growth and color vibrancy. Its moderate growth rate allows for easy shaping, and simple stem cuttings make propagation straightforward. Key Benefits Unique Purple Coloration: Adds a bold, exotic color to aquascapes, making it a visually striking choice. Versatile Planting Options: Ideal for midground or background placement, creating depth and contrast. Easy Propagation: Propagate by stem cuttings to grow more plants easily. Low to Moderate Maintenance: Suitable for hobbyists of all levels, thriving under medium to high lighting. Bacopa Salzmannii 'Purple' is a must-have for aquascapers seeking bold, eye-catching designs. It’s a versatile plant that transforms any aquascape into a vibrant, colorful display.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 紫虎耳原产南美洲湿地，叶片呈紫色和绿色。中高强度光照更有利于紫色发色，适合放在中景或后景。富含养分的底床、定期施肥和补充 CO₂ 有助于维持生长与色彩。生长速度中等，可通过茎段扦插繁殖。

detail_list.name: Blyxa japonica
detail_list.introduction: The Blyxa japonica originates in the nutrient rich shallow pools of water, swamps and slowly flowing rivers in East and South East Asia. The plant has gained notoriety thanks to the late Takashi Amano and his aquarium works from the 90s. Blyxa has a distinct grass-like appearance that moves easily in the circulating aquarium water creating a sense of dynamicity in comparison to other more robust plants.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 日本箦藻原产于东亚和东南亚富含营养的浅水池、沼泽和缓慢流动的河流中。由于 Takashi Amano 先生在 90 年代的水族箱作品，这种水草获得了广泛的认可。日本箦藻具有明显的草本外观，能够在循环水流中轻松摆动，与其它更为粗壮的水草相比，营造出一种动态感。

detail_list.name: Bolbitis heudelotii
detail_list.introduction: Bolbitis comes from West Africa, a fern with beautiful, transparent green leaves, 15-40 cm tall and wide. When planting, do not cover the rhizome because it will rot, and it is best to plant Bolbitis heudelotii on a root or stone. Keep the plant in position with fishing line until it has gained a hold. Easy to propagate by splitting the horizontal rhizome. Supply of CO2 will considerably enhance the growth, which is only optimal in soft, slightly acidic water.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 黑木蕨原产于西非，是一种叶片美丽透明绿色的蕨类水草，高度和宽度可达15-40 厘米。种植时不要覆盖根茎，否则会腐烂，最好将黑木蕨种植在根或石材上。用鱼线固定植株直到其稳固生长。通过分割水平根茎的方式容易繁殖。提供 CO₂将大大增强其生长，最佳生长条件为软水和微酸性水。

detail_list.introduction: In nature, Bucephalandra usually grows on rocks or wood in rivers and streams - much like Anubias, which they resemble regarding use and care in the aquarium. Bucephalandra 'Wavy Green' is an easy, slow-growing plant that prefers lower light levels. A nice, dense appearance is ensured by the willingness to branch, even without trimming. The green leaves are 2 cm wide and 5 cm long with wavy edges. Tiny white spots will appear on immerse leaves. The creeping stem, rhizome, must not be covered when planting. This will cause the plant to rot and die.

The green leaves are 2 cm wide and 5 cm long with wavy edges. Tiny white spots will appear on immerse leaves. The creeping stem, rhizome, must not be covered when planting. This will cause the plant to rot and die.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 本产品为附生在熔岩石上的黑山辣椒榕。它生长缓慢、容易养护，适合较弱光照；在自然环境中也附生于河流和溪流里的石材或沉木上，用法和养护方式与水榕相近。不修剪也容易分枝并形成浓密株丛。绿色叶片宽约 2 厘米、长约 5 厘米，叶缘呈波浪状，水上叶会出现细小白点。栽种时不要掩埋匍匐根茎，否则植株会腐烂。

detail_list.introduction: Plant in 5 cm pot. detail_list.introduction_cn: 黑山辣椒榕为 5 厘米盆栽水草。它生长缓慢、容易养护，适合较弱光照；在自然环境中附生于河流和溪流里的石材或沉木上，用法和养护方式与水榕相近。不修剪也容易分枝并形成浓密株丛。绿色叶片宽约 2 厘米、长约 5 厘米，叶缘呈波浪状，水上叶会出现细小白点。栽种时不要掩埋匍匐根茎，否则植株会腐烂。

detail_list.name: Bucephalandra sordidula 'Blue'
detail_list.introduction: Bucephalandra Sordidula 'Blue' is a highly sought-after plant known for its unique, shimmering blue leaves, which add a rare touch of elegance and sophistication to aquascapes. Native to Borneo’s riverbanks, this plant is a perfect choice for creating natural, jungle-inspired scenes with rich textures and subtle hues. Its leaves display a captivating blue sheen that varies with lighting, making it ideal for aquarists seeking something truly special. Slow-growing and easy to maintain, Bucephalandra 'Blue' thrives in low to moderate light, though higher lighting can enhance its color. This plant is versatile and hardy, adapting well to most aquarium conditions, making it suitable for beginners and experts alike. It’s best placed in the midground or foreground, where its unique color and texture can be admired up close. Attach it to driftwood or rocks for a natural look that mimics its natural habitat. Key Benefits Unique Blue Sheen: Adds an exotic and subtle color. Low Maintenance: Thrives in a range of conditions. Versatile Placement: Perfect for midground or foreground. Natural Aquascaping: Ideal for attaching to hardscape elements. Slow Growth: Retains its form with minimal trimming. Bucephalandra Sordidula 'Blue' is a show-stopper for aquascapers who appreciate the rare and beautiful. Its unique colors, ease of care, and versatility make it a favorite for creating elegant, natural aquascapes.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 蓝色辣椒榕原产婆罗洲河岸，叶片在光线下会呈现蓝色光泽。它生长缓慢，养护要求不高，低到中等光照即可生长；较强光照可让色泽更明显。适合固定在沉木或石材上，用作前景或中景。

detail_list.name: Bucephalandra sp. 'Needle Leaf'
detail_list.introduction: Though Bucephalandras are from Asia and Anubias fom Africa, they have a lot in common, including how to grow them. Bucephalandra sp. 'Needle leaf' has a bit higher demands than the 'diabolica' and pygmaeae, but is still a very easy plant to grow. Some added CO2 and a little more light is beneficial. Immersed leaves are green, elongated and slightly waved, showing numerous tiny, white dots. Each leaf is less than 0.5 cm broad and between 1 and 2 cm long. Youngest parts of the rhizome display a nice, red colour. Growth is slow. The creeping rhizome must not be covered when planting, otherwise the plant will rot and die.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 针叶辣椒榕来自亚洲，生长和养护方式与非洲水榕有不少相似之处。它比 'diabolica' 和 'pygmaeae' 两类辣椒榕的要求稍高，但仍然容易栽培；适量补充 CO₂ 并提高一些光照会更有利。水上叶绿色、细长且略带波浪，表面散布细小白点，叶宽不足 0.5 厘米、长约 1-2 厘米。根茎新生部位呈红色，整体生长缓慢。栽种时不要掩埋匍匐根茎，否则植株会腐烂。

detail_list.name: Bucephalandra sp. 'Red'
detail_list.introduction: Red Bucephalandra varieties, potted. The Bucephalandra resemble Anubias very much and should be treated the same way. They usually grow more or less epiphytic in or near water. Bucephalandra sp. 'Red' does best at lower light levels and is very easy to grow. The leaves are of a very dark green or leathery red colour. Numerous tiny, white dots and sometimes a faint, metallic, blue colour will appear on submerse leaves. Size of leaf is 2-4 cm wide, 4-6 cm long and usually it will present wavy edges. Do not cover the creeping rhizome when planting. This will cause the plant to rot and die.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 本产品为盆栽红辣椒榕。辣椒榕的形态和养护方式与水榕相近，在自然环境中通常附生于水边或水中的石材、沉木上。红辣椒榕适合较弱光照，容易栽培。叶片呈深绿色或皮革红色，水下叶散布细小白点，有时带淡淡的金属蓝色；叶宽约 2-4 厘米、长约 4-6 厘米，叶缘通常呈波浪状。栽种时不要掩埋匍匐根茎，否则植株会腐烂。

detail_list.name: Cabomba aquatica
detail_list.introduction: Cabomba is a very popular aquarium plant from South America owing to its beautiful foliage. It reaches 30-80 cm and each stem can become 5-8 cm wide. The least demanding of the Cabomba-species, but still causes problems in poorly lit aquariums. If there is not sufficient light, try Limnophila sessiliflora, which requires less light. Most decorative when planted in groups. Eaten locally as a vegetable. A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. Regarding stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2“). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance into the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant start growing.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 黄花穗莼是一种来自南美洲的非常受欢迎的水草，以其叶片而著称。它的株高可达30-80 厘米，每株茎的宽度可达5-8 厘米。它是 Cabomba 属中最易养护的种类之一，但在光照不足的水族箱中仍会遇到问题。如果光照不足，可以尝试使用小宝塔，它对光照的要求较低。黄花穗莼成群种植时最为美观。在当地被作为蔬菜食用。通常以一束茎或幼苗捆绑在配重环中出售。移除锚后，将植株分开种植。对于有茎草，应将距离底部5 厘米（2 英寸）以内的叶片去除。移除任何受损的叶片。将单株植株间隔一定距离种植在底床上。很快就会生根并开始生长。

detail_list.name: Cardamine lyrata
detail_list.introduction: Cardamine lyrata is actually a marsh plant from Japan. But it is also a familiar aquarium plant which thrives under water with 20-50 cm long stems. A characteristic trailing growth form makes it highly decorative, and ‘aerial’ roots often form on the plant itself. Plant it in groups, and make sure the water temperature does not exceed 28 degrees C (this makes the leaves much smaller and the plant more leggy). Also suitable in garden ponds in the summer.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 苹果草实际上是一种来自日本的沼泽植物。但它也是一种常见的水草，能够在水中生长，茎长20-50 厘米。其独特的匍匐生长方式使其极具观赏性，而且植株上常会长出气生根。建议成簇种植，并确保水温不超过28 摄氏度（这会使叶子变小且植株变得细长）。夏季也适合在花园池塘中种植。

detail_list.name: Ceratophyllum demersum
detail_list.introduction: Ceratophyllum demersum was found in a smaller tributary in Bolivia during an expedition to Rio Guapore, a boundary river between Brazil and Bolivia. Ceratophyllum has no roots as such, but it is nevertheless possible to plant it in the bottom of an aquarium and stems can become up to 80 cm tall and 5 cm wide. Ceratophyllum demersum differs because its leaves are closer together and it has lateral shoots, which gives it an attractive, compact appearance. The plant also distinguishes itself because it is hardier and its stalks do not break as easily as those of other Ceratophyllum-varieties.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 金鱼藻在巴西和玻利维亚边界河流 Rio Guapore 的一次考察中，在玻利维亚的一条较小支流中被发现。金鱼藻没有根，但可以将其茎插入水族箱底部，其茎可以长到80 厘米高，5 厘米宽。金鱼藻的特点是叶片更紧密，且有侧枝，使其外观更加紧凑美观。金鱼藻比其他 Ceratophyllum 品种更耐寒，茎也更不易折断。

detail_list.name: Ceratopteris thalictroides
detail_list.introduction: Ceratopteris thalictroides is a pantropical fern, 15-30 cm high and 10-20 cm wide.. This plant normally grows fast, but the addition of CO2 may be necessary to promote growth. In small, open aquariums, it can grow out of the tank and form beautiful surface leaves. The finely branched leaves are very decorative and provide good contrast to other leaf shapes. In good light Ceratopteris thalictroides grows fast and helps prevent algae by consuming large amounts of nutrients. This makes it a good starter plant in small aquariums.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 水蕨广布于热带地区，株高约 15-30 厘米，株幅约 10-20 厘米。它通常生长较快，必要时可补充 CO₂ 促进生长。在小型开放式水族箱中，叶片可以伸出水面并形成水上叶。细密分枝的叶片观赏性较好，也能与其他叶形形成对比。光照充足时，水蕨会快速吸收大量养分，帮助抑制藻类，因此很适合作为小型水族箱的开缸草。

detail_list.name: Crinum calamistratum
detail_list.introduction: Crinum calamistratum from West Africa is a very graceful bulbous plant with dark-green, very narrow leaves. The curly leaves becomes 40-120 cm long. It forms smaller bulbs than the other Crinum-species, and requires less light. In the aquarium plants that are thriving form a number of small bulbs. It is not eaten by herbivorous fish. It can also be used in brackish aquariums with low salt concentrations.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 小喷泉草来自西非，是一种非常优雅的球有茎草，其叶片呈深绿色且非常细长。叶片卷曲，长度可达40-120 厘米。它形成的球茎比其他 Crinum 属植物要小，且需要的光照较少。在水族箱中，生长良好的植株会形成多个小球茎。它不会被食草鱼食用。也可以用于低盐浓度的半咸水水族箱中。

detail_list.name: Crinum thaianum
detail_list.introduction: Large motherplant, grown in a 9 cm square pot. Crinum thaianum from Thailand is a distinctive bulbous plant belonging to the lily family having 60-200 cm long leaves. It is undemanding apart from the fact that it needs plenty of space. Keep the top 2/3 of the bulb visible when you plant it because otherwise the bulb tends to rot. When the plant grows older it sometimes sends a flower stem up to the water surface with an aromatic, elegant lily flower.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 泰国水蒜来自泰国，是一种独特的球根植物，属于百合科。其叶片长度可达60-200 厘米。泰国水蒜对环境要求不高，但需要足够的生长空间。种植时要确保球根的上部2/3露出底床，否则球根容易腐烂。通常种植在9 厘米方盆中。随着植株年龄的增长，有时会从水中伸出花茎，开出芳香优雅的百合花。

detail_list.introduction_cn: 泰国水蒜来自泰国，是一种百合科球有茎草，叶片长度可达60-200 厘米。除了需要大量空间外，这种水草养护要求不高。种植时要让球茎的顶部2/3露出底床，否则球茎容易腐烂。随着植株年龄增长，有时会从水中伸出花茎，开出带有香气的优雅百合花。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne albida 'Brown'
detail_list.introduction: This little Cryptocoryne comes from Asia, and grows naturally in for instance Thailand. The narrow, red-brown leaves have clear, black patterns and beautifully waving leaf edges. Each leaf grows to be about 1-3 cm wide and up to 15 cm long, giving the plant a light and graceful look, which is easy to combine with other plants inside the aquarium, enabling beautiful contrasts. Like many other Cryptocorynes, it is able to grow under must conditions and can thrive at even very poor light conditions. However, it will only grow very slow under such conditions.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 棕色阿尔比达椒草来自亚洲，自然生长于泰国等地。其狭长的红棕色叶片上有着清晰的黑色图案和优美的波浪形叶缘。每片叶子宽约1-3 厘米，长可达15 厘米，赋予植株轻盈优雅的外观，容易与其他水草搭配，营造出对比效果。和许多其他椒草一样，它能在各种条件下生长，甚至在非常弱的光照条件下也能存活，但生长速度会非常缓慢。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne beckettii 'Petchii'
detail_list.introduction: Cryptocoryne beckettii 'Petchii' is a small variety of Cryptocoryne beckettii from Sri Lanka, which has beautiful, slightly fluted leaf margins, 10-15 cm long. Leaves become dark olive-brown with violet underside. Like many other Cryptocorynes, the leaf colour and shape depends largely on environmental conditions in the aquarium.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 贝克椒草是一种来自斯里兰卡的小型贝克椒草品种，叶片边缘略呈波浪状，长度为10-15 厘米。叶片呈现深橄榄棕色，叶背为紫色。和许多其他 Cryptocoryne 品种一样，其叶片的颜色和形状很大程度上取决于水族箱内的环境条件。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne crispatula
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Cryptocoryne crispatula var. balansae is from the limestone mountains of Southern Thailand, where the water can be very hard. It is not very demanding, but appreciates a nutritious substrate and good light. Like many other Cryptocorynes it needs to acclimatize before growth starts in earnest. Leaves becomes 20-60 cm long and the single roset plant becomes 15-20 cm wide. Place it in the rear part of the tank, from where the leaves may float beautifully on the water surface. The leaves are either entirely green or maroon.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 缎带椒草（Cryptocoryne crispatula var. balansae）采用密封杯组织培养，原产泰国南部石灰岩山区，当地水质可能很硬。它要求不高，但更喜欢养分充足的底床和良好光照。和许多椒草一样，入缸后需要先适应环境，之后才会明显生长。叶片长约 20-60 厘米，单个莲座丛宽约 15-20 厘米，适合种在后景，让长叶沿水面舒展。叶色可能为全绿或栗红色。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne crispatula
detail_list.introduction: Cryptocoryne crispatula var. balansae is from Southern Thailand where there are limestone mountains, and the water can be very hard. Like many other Cryptocorynes it needs to acclimatise before growth starts in earnest. Leaves becomes 20-60 cm long and the single roset plant becomes 15-20 cm wide.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 缎带椒草（Cryptocoryne crispatula var. balansae）原产泰国南部石灰岩山区，当地水质可能很硬。和许多椒草一样，入缸后需要先适应环境，之后才会明显生长。叶片长约 20-60 厘米，单个莲座丛宽约 15-20 厘米。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne nurii
detail_list.introduction: This beautiful variation of Cryptocoryne nurii was found growing in the wild in Malaysia around 1970. In the aquarium hobby it became popular under the name 'Rose Maiden'. The plant is as easy to grow as Cryptocoryne wendtii and has the same size and leaf shape. It will, given the time, produce runners under the bottom layer, often showing up quite far from the mother plant. Intensity of colour and patterns in leaves is dependant on light and nutrition.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 虎斑椒草这种变种于1970年左右在马来西亚野外被发现。在水族箱爱好中，它以“Rose Maiden”之名流行起来。这种水草的栽培难度与 Cryptocoryne wendtii 相近，植株大小和叶片形状也相似。给足时间，它会在底床下生成走茎，走茎常常会出现在距离母株较远的地方。叶片的颜色和图案取决于光照和营养。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne parva
detail_list.introduction: Cryptocoryne parva fromac Sri Lanka is the smallest of all Cryptocorynes (only 3-6 cm tall and a roset less than 5-8 cm wide). It is one of the few species that does not significantly change its leaf shape and colour depending on cultivation conditions. It needs more light than most other Cryptocorynes because it almost loses its leaf plate under water. So, it must never be overshadowed by other plants. Known for its slow growth, but Nutrition Capsules in the bottom layer will enhance the development. Individual plants should be planted a few centimetres apart, and after about six months they will form a cohesive low group of plants. Very recommendable foreground plant.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 迷你椒草来自斯里兰卡，是所有 Cryptocoryne 品种中最小的（高度仅3-6 厘米，莲座丛直径不足5-8 厘米）。与其他 Cryptocoryne 品种相比，它很少因栽培条件的变化而改变叶片形状和颜色。由于迷你椒草在水中几乎会失去叶片，因此需要比其他 Cryptocoryne 品种更多的光照，不能被其他植物遮挡。迷你椒草生长缓慢，但可以在底床铺设营养胶囊以促进其生长。单株植物之间应保持几厘米的距离，大约六个月后，它们将形成一个紧密的低矮植株群。适合作为前景草使用。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne parva
detail_list.introduction: Cryptocoryne parva fromac Sri Lanka is the smallest of all Cryptocorynes (only 3-6 cm tall and a roset less than 5-8 cm wide). It is one of the few species that does not significantly change its leaf shape and colour depending on cultivation conditions. It needs more light than most other Cryptocorynes because it almost loses its leaf plate under water. So, it must never be overshadowed by other plants. Known for its slow growth, but Nutrition Capsules in the bottom layer will enhance the development. Individual plants should be planted a few centimetres apart, and after about six months they will form a cohesive low group of plants. Very recommendable foreground plant.

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne spiralis 'Red'
detail_list.introduction: Cryptocoryne spiralis 'Red' is one of many varieties of Cryptocoryne spiralis, commonly found in India. In the aquarium, this plant can grow to over 50 cm in height. The narrow, upright leaves are 1-1.5 cm wide with softly waved edges and sometimes a less visible green mid-stripe, depending on the conditions in the aquarium. Cryptocoryne spiralis 'Red' is not difficult to grow, but it requires good light and nutrition to reach its full potential.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 红螺旋椒草是 Cryptocoryne spiralis 的多个品种之一，常见于印度。在水族箱中，这种水草可以长到超过50 厘米的高度。其狭长直立的叶片宽度为1-1.5 厘米，边缘柔软波状，有时在水族箱条件的影响下，中间的绿色条纹不太明显。红螺旋椒草并不难养，但要达到最佳状态，需要充足的光照和营养。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne undulata 'Broad Leaf'
detail_list.introduction: The triploid variety of Cryptocoryne undulata from Sri Lanka has wider leaves and a beautiful, flecked leaf pattern. It also grows larger, from 15-30 cm, and the single roset becomes 10-20 cm wide. It is a hardy plant and do well under many growing conditions.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 三倍体的来自斯里兰卡的宽叶波浪椒草拥有更宽的叶片和斑点叶纹。植株生长更大，高度在15-30 厘米之间，单个莲座丛可达到10-20 厘米宽。它是一种耐寒的水草，适应多种生长条件。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne undulata 'Broad Leaf'
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. This red version of Cryptocoryne undulata grows wild in rivers of Sri Lanka. It is an easy plant, tolerant of very different conditions in an aquarium. Appearance of the plant will partially depend on these conditions. Low levels of light and nutrients will produce a relatively tall, greenish-brown plant of slow growth. Higher levels of light and nutrition, combined with added CO2, will make the plant grow considerably faster producing shorter leaves of a reddish-brown colour.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 宽叶波浪椒草采用密封杯组织培养，是斯里兰卡河流中野生分布的红色型 Cryptocoryne undulata。它容易养护，能适应差异较大的缸内环境，株型也会随条件改变。光照和养分较少时，植株较高，叶片呈绿褐色，生长缓慢；提高光照和养分并补充 CO₂ 后，生长会明显加快，叶片更短并呈红褐色。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne usteriana
detail_list.introduction: Cryptocoryne usteriana is one of the taller cryptocorynes and is very easy to grow. Leaves are 3-5 cm wide with an embossed surface, they can easily reach more than 50 cm length. With good light and fertilization, the upper side of the leaves will obtain a dark green or bronze-green colour while the back of the leaves will turn burgundy red. Propagation is by long runners, and the plant tolerates quite alkaline water very well.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 气泡椒草是一种较高的椒草，非常容易养殖。叶片宽3-5 厘米，表面有浮雕质感，长度可以轻松超过50 厘米。在良好的光照和施肥条件下，叶片正面会呈现深绿色或青铜绿色，背面则会变成紫红色。气泡椒草通过长走茎繁殖，能很好地适应偏碱性的水质。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne wendtii 'Green'
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Cryptocoryne wendtii ‘Green' presents beautiful, green leaves. Depending on your aquarium setup wendtii ‘Green' can reach a height of 10-30 cm with rosets ranging from 8-15 cm wide. When grown in an open space the leaves will virtually lie on the bottom. Like most other Sri Lanka Cryptocorynes, it also grows well in hard water. Easy to grow, it thrives in almost all conditions, even in the shadow of larger plants. A fresh green group of Cryptocoryne wendtii ‘Green' will decorate any tank.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 绿温蒂椒草采用密封杯组织培养。叶片呈鲜绿色，株高会随缸内条件变化，约为 10-30 厘米，莲座丛宽约 8-15 厘米。在开阔处种植时，叶片几乎贴着底床展开。和大多数斯里兰卡椒草一样，它也能适应硬水。养护简单，对环境的适应范围很广，在大型水草的遮阴下仍可正常生长。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne wendtii 'Green'
detail_list.introduction: Cryptocoryne wendtii ‘Green' presents beautiful, green leaves. Depending on your aquarium setup wendtii ‘Green' can reach a height of 10-30 cm with rosets ranging from 8-15 cm wide. When grown in an open space the leaves will virtually lie on the bottom. Like most other Sri Lanka Cryptocorynes, it also grows well in hard water.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 绿温蒂椒草拥有绿色叶片。根据水族箱的设置，绿温蒂椒草的高度可达10-30 厘米，莲座丛的宽度为8-15 厘米。在开阔的空间中生长时，叶片几乎会平铺在底床上。与其他来自斯里兰卡的椒草一样，它在硬水中生长良好。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne wendtii 'Mi Oya'
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. This beautiful variety of Cryptocoryne wendtii is only found in the river Mi Oya at Sri Lanka. It has characteristic red-brown, slightly hammered leaves from 20-35 cm, and 15-30 cm wide rosettes. Many Cryptocorynes can grow at high temperatures. In the wild this plant is found in streams with a temperature of more than 30 degrees C.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 宓大屋温蒂椒草采用密封杯组织培养，只见于斯里兰卡的 Mi Oya 河。红褐色叶片略带锤纹，长约 20-35 厘米，莲座丛宽约 15-30 厘米。许多椒草可以适应高温环境；这种椒草在野外就生长于水温超过 30 摄氏度的溪流中。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne wendtii 'Tropica'
detail_list.introduction: Large motherplant, grown in a 9 cm square pot. This beautiful variety with the dark, hammered leaves is named after 'Tropica'. When grown in an open space the leaves will virtually lie on the bottom. It is suitable for small aquariums with leaves from 10-20 cm, and a rosette from 10-20 cm wide. Like most other Sri Lanka Cryptocorynes, it also grows well in hard water.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 特罗皮卡温蒂椒草是一种大型植株，通常种植在9 厘米方盆中。这种叶片深色且表面有锤纹的美丽品种以'Tropica'命名。在开阔的空间中种植时，其叶片几乎会平铺在底床上。适合小型水族箱，叶片长度在10-20 厘米之间，莲座丛宽度也在10-20 厘米之间。与其他来自斯里兰卡的 Cryptocoryne 品种一样，它在硬水中生长良好。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne x willisii
detail_list.introduction: No other stem plant can boast colors as rich as those in this particular variety. Brown-red through cherry red hues drift over the stems, and the upper and lower surfaces of the leaves. To ensure that you get the most intense colors, this plant needs good lighting and an adequate supply of CO2. Speed of growth is generally average, so it is advisable to trim the stems every 6–8 weeks. In discus aquariums this South American plant adds a splash of color when combined with sword plants.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 威利斯椒草原产斯里兰卡，过去常被误称为 Cryptocoryne nevillii，但后者实际上并未用于水族栽培。它和许多椒草一样，种下后的第一个月生长不明显，适应后会长出大量走茎并形成紧密株丛。株高约 7-20 厘米，单个莲座丛宽约 7-15 厘米。

detail_list.name: Cryptocoryne x willisii
detail_list.introduction: Live aquatic plant in pot, packed in a breathable blister packaging to go. This Cryptocoryne from Sri Lanka used (mistakenly) to be called Cryptocoryne nevillii, but this is the name of a species that has never been used in aquariums. Like many other Cryptocorynes, not much happens the first month after planting. But then it starts to grow, and willingly produces plenty of runners which form a compact group. The plant becomes 7-20 cm tall, and each roset 7-15 cm wide.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 盆栽水草，采用透气吸塑包装。这款来自斯里兰卡的威利斯椒草常被误称为 Cryptocoryne nevillii，但后者实际上从未在水族箱中使用过。与其他椒草类似，种植后的第一个月内生长缓慢。但之后开始生长，并且会大量产生走茎，形成紧凑的群体。植株高度可达7-20 厘米，每个莲座丛直径可达7-15 厘米。

detail_list.name: Cyperus helferi
detail_list.introduction: Cyperus-species are widespread all over the tropics, but only a few of them are good underwater plants. Cyperus helferi from Thailand is the first Cyperus-species used in aquariums, 20-35 cm tall and a roset from 15-25 cm wide. It requires a relatively large amount of light, and CO2 addition is recommended to promote growth. In aquariums with good water flow the plant sways beautifully in the current.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 莎草属水草广泛分布于热带地区，但只有少数品种适合作为水草。来自泰国的喷泉莎草是最早用于水族箱的莎草属品种之一，高度可达20-35 厘米，莲座丛直径为15-25 厘米。它需要相对充足的光照，并且推荐添加 CO₂以促进生长。在水流良好的水族箱中，喷泉莎草会在水流中优美地摇曳。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus 'Aquartica'
detail_list.introduction: Characteristics of the cultivar Echinodorus 'Aquartica' are its round, bright green leaves. Its compact (10-20 cm), low growth makes it suitable as a decorative solitary plant. Slow growing and easy to care for, Echinodorus 'Aquartica' retains the refreshing green colour of its leaves in normal lighting and nutrient conditions in the aquarium. The plant is a cross between several different cultivated plants, including Echinodorus horemanii and several round-leafed Echinodorus species. Echinodorus 'Aquartica' was developed by Kristian Iversen from the "Aquartica" company.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 阿夸提卡皇冠草的特征是其圆形、鲜绿色的叶片。其紧凑的生长（高度10-20 厘米）使其适合作为装饰性单株植物。阿夸提卡皇冠草生长缓慢且易于照料，在正常光照和营养条件下，叶片能保持鲜绿的颜色。该品种是通过几种栽培植物杂交而成，包括 Echinodorus horemanii 和几种圆形叶片的 Echinodorus 物种。阿夸提卡皇冠草由 Kristian Iversen 的“Aquartica”公司开发。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus cordifolius 'Fluitans'
detail_list.introduction: A comparatively fast-growing Echinodorus from Mexico, suitable for large aquariums reaching 20-50 cm long leaves and a 15-30 cm wide roset. Easy and undemanding, excellent plant for beginners. Its wavy, light green leaves are very decorative. Unlike other round-leafed varieties of the species, Echinodorus cordifolius fluitans is less likely to grow up over the water surface. If it grows large enough, it forms large leaves just under the surface instead.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 来自墨西哥的较快生长的象耳皇冠品种，适合大型水族箱，可长至20-50 厘米长的叶子和15-30 厘米宽的莲座丛。生长容易，需求不高，是初学者的理想水草。其波浪状的浅绿色叶子非常美观。与该物种的其他圆形叶子品种不同，漂浮象耳皇冠较少长出水面。如果生长足够大，它会在水面下形成大型叶子。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus grisebachii 'Bleherae'
detail_list.introduction: Echinodorus bleheri from South America is undemanding and beautiful, and becomes 20-50 cm tall. A nutritious bottom promotes growth, but the plant needs pruning to prevent it depriving plants underneath of light. Echinodorus bleheri does well even in poorly illuminated aquariums, as it grows towards the light. It is a hardy and easy solitary plant for both beginners and the more experienced with quite large aquariums. It has been sold under the name "Paniculatus". A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. Regarding stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2“). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance into the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant start growing.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 亚马逊皇冠草来自南美洲，需求不高且美丽，可长至20-50 厘米高。营养丰富的底床能促进其生长，但需要定期修剪以防止其遮挡下方植物的光照。即使在光照不足的水族箱中，亚马逊皇冠草也能很好地生长，因为它会向着光源生长。它是一种耐寒且容易养护的单株植物，适合初学者和拥有较大水族箱的资深玩家。它曾被误称为“Paniculatus”。亚马逊皇冠草以锚状捆绑的茎或幼株出售。移除锚后，将植株分开种植。对于有茎草，需去除距离底部5 厘米（2 英寸）内的叶子。移除任何受损的叶子。将单株植物间隔一定距离种植在底床上。很快就会生根并开始生长。

detail_list.introduction: Echinodorus grisebachii 'Tropica', also known as Echinodorus parviflorus 'Tropica', is a small, distinctive sword plant that was discovered in the Tropica nursery in Denmark during the 1980s. This plant is well-suited for the foreground or middle ground of aquariums due to its compact size, which typically ranges from 5 to 10 cm in height. It forms a spreading rosette of medium to dark green, slightly bullate leaves that are narrow and obovate, resembling Samolus valerandi.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 新卵圆皇冠草，也被称为 Echinodorus parviflorus 'Tropica'，是一种小型独特的剑叶草，于20世纪80年代在丹麦的 Tropica 苗圃中被发现。由于其紧凑的体型，通常高度在5-10 厘米之间，这种水草适合用于水族箱的前景或中景。它形成一个扩展的莲座丛，叶片为中到深绿色，略带凸起，形状狭长且倒卵形，类似于 Samolus valerandi。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus 'Ozelot'
detail_list.introduction: Large motherplant, grown in a 9 cm square pot. Echinodorus 'Ozelot' is a decorative hybrid between Echinodorus schluteri 'Leopard' and Echinodorus ‘Barthii’. 20-50 cm tall and a 20-40 cm wide rosette. Naturally, it is the elliptical black spots on the red-brown leaves that have given this plant the name 'Ozelot'. The spots are darkest on the youngest leaves, and unlike many other spotted Echinodorus, 'Ozelot' retains its spots even at low light intensity. It is an undemanding and good plant for beginners.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 豹纹皇冠草是一种装饰性杂交品种，由 Echinodorus schluteri 'Leopard' 和皇冠草属 ‘Barthii’ 杂交而成。植株高度可达20-50 厘米，莲座丛宽度为20-40 厘米。其椭圆形的黑色斑点分布在红棕色的叶片上，赋予了这种植物“豹纹皇冠草”的名字。这些斑点在最年轻的叶片上最为深色，与许多其他斑点型皇冠草不同，'Ozelot' 即使在低光照条件下也能保持斑点。它是一种易于养护的植物，适合初学者。通常种植在9 厘米方盆中。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus 'Ozelot Green'
detail_list.introduction: A beautiful, dark-green variety of Echinodorus 'Ozelot', 20-50 cm tall and a 20-40 cm wide rosette. The dark spots form a bigger contrast on the light leaves. The leaf margin is fluted. A nutritious bottom promotes growth. It is an easy and highly recommended plant, which thrives in almost all conditions.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 绿豹纹皇冠草，一种深绿色豹纹皇冠草品种，高度可达20-50 厘米，莲座丛宽度为20-40 厘米。深色斑点在浅色叶片上形成了更大的对比。叶缘呈波纹状。营养丰富的底床能促进其生长。它是一种易于养护且非常推荐的水草，几乎适应所有条件。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus 'Red Diamond'
detail_list.introduction: Echinodorus 'Red Diamond' appeared as a culture in the Ukraine, and is probably a cross between Echinodorus horemanni 'Red' and Echinodorus ‘Barthii’. The resultant hybrid is an attractive plant with ruby-red sword-shaped leaves, 15-25 cm long. Unlike many of the other Echinodorus-species, Echinodorus 'Red Diamond' remains moderate in size (20-30 cm wide roset), so it is extremely well suited as a solitary plant, even in small aquariums. Increasing the nutrients in the substrate results in more abundant growth, while favourable light conditions promote the formation of the ruby-red leaves.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 红钻皇冠草是在乌克兰出现的栽培品种，可能由 Echinodorus horemanni 'Red' 与 Echinodorus 'Barthii' 杂交而来。剑形叶片呈宝石红色，长约 15-25 厘米；莲座丛宽约 20-30 厘米，株型比许多皇冠草更适中，即使在小型水族箱中也适合作为单株焦点。提高底床养分可使生长更旺盛，良好光照则有利于红色叶片的形成。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus 'Reni'
detail_list.introduction: 'Reni' is a well-known cultivar characterized by being easy to grow and amongst the smallest of the red Echinodorus, 15-40 cm tall and a roset from 15-25 wide. The new leaves of the plant are reddish-brown to deep beetroot in colour. It can be used in small aquariums and is unpretentious. The plant requires a lot of light and nourishment for optimal colour development.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 蕊妮皇冠草是一种广受欢迎的品种，以其易养和较小的株型著称，是红皇冠草属中较小的一种，高度在15-40 厘米之间，莲座丛直径为15-25 厘米。新叶呈现红褐色至深紫红色。它适合小型水族箱，且养护要求不高。为了达到最佳的色彩效果，该水草需要充足的光照和营养。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus 'Rosé'
detail_list.introduction: Large motherplant, grown in a 9 cm square pot. This beautiful plant is a hybrid between Echinodorus horemanii ‘Red’ and Echinodorus horizontalis. It was first produced in 1986 by Hans Barth in Dessau and becomes 25-40 cm tall and a rosette from 15-25 cm wide. New underwater leaves are a beautiful pink, and initially the leaves have red-brown spots. A nutritious bottom promotes growth, but otherwise Echinodorus 'Rosé' is undemanding and thus an excellent plant for beginners.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 大型玫瑰皇冠草母株种植在 9 厘米方盆中。它是 Echinodorus horemanii 'Red' 与 Echinodorus horizontalis 的杂交品种，1986 年由 Hans Barth 在德绍首次培育。株高约 25-40 厘米，莲座丛宽约 15-25 厘米。新长出的水下叶呈粉红色，初期带有红褐色斑点。富含养分的底床有助于生长，其他养护要求不高，适合新手。

detail_list.name: Echinodorus x barthii
detail_list.introduction: The cultivar Echinodorus ‘Barthii’ is a decorative and beautiful solitary plant for large aquariums. It becomes 25-50 cm tall and the whole rosette 20-30 cm wide. The leaves change colour from dark-red in the youngest leaves to dark-green in the oldest. The colour develops well when the light intensity is high and there are sufficient micronutrients in the aquarium. A nutritious bottom and CO2 addition promote growth. This plant takes a lot of light from plants underneath, so it must be pruned occasionally. It used to be sold as "Double Red".
detail_list.introduction_cn: 红香瓜草适合在大型水族箱中单株种植。株高约 25-50 厘米，莲座丛宽约 20-30 厘米；新叶呈深红色，老叶会逐渐转为深绿色。较强光照和充足的微量元素有利于发色，富含养分的底床和补充 CO₂ 可促进生长。植株会遮挡下方水草，需要适时修剪。这个品种过去曾以“Double Red”的名称销售。

detail_list.name: Egeria densa
detail_list.introduction: The cosmopolitan Egeria densa is a good plant for beginners, and its rapid growth helps create a balance in the aquarium from the start. Stems grows fast to 40-100 cm and becomes 2-4 cm wide. Egeria helps preventing algae because it absorbs a great number of nutrients from the water. The growth rate depends largely on the amount of light and nutrition available. Growth does not stop in unfavourable conditions, but the plant turns light in colour and the tendrils grow thin. A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. Regarding stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2“). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance into the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant start growing.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 水蕴草是全球分布的品种，适合初学者养殖。它生长迅速，有助于从一开始就建立水族箱内的平衡。茎的长度可以达到40-100 厘米，宽度为2-4 厘米。水蕴草能有效抑制藻类生长，因为它能吸收大量的养分。其生长速度主要取决于光照和营养的多少。即使在不利条件下，水蕴草的生长也不会停止，但植株会变淡，须根也会变细。可以将一束茎或幼苗用锚固定。移除锚后，将茎分成单独的植株。对于有茎草，需要去除距离底部5 厘米内的叶子。移除任何受损的叶子。将单独的植株间隔一定距离种植在底床上。不久后，根系将发展起来，植株开始生长。

detail_list.name: Eleocharis acicularis
detail_list.introduction: Eleocharis acicularis is very common and thrives in almost all conditions in an aquarium. An open space without shading from other plants is still preferable. After planting, the roots will start colonizing the surroundings, creating a beautiful carpet of 6-15 cm height. If the carpet grows too tall, you may carefully cut it back to the preferred height.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 牛毛毡非常常见，几乎能在水族箱内的所有条件下生长。不过，它更偏好开放空间，不受其他植物遮挡。种植后，其根茎会开始在周围区域扩散，形成一片高度为6-15 厘米的草坪。如果草坪长势过高，可以小心修剪至所需高度。

detail_list.name: Eleocharis montevidensis
detail_list.introduction: This American Eleocharis has a fresh grass green colour and grows to be 20-40cm high. It is basic and low maintenance. Each straw is only few millimeters thick and the plant maintains an open form of growth. It is suitable as a background plant, and can further be planted in front and in the centre of the aquarium, in transparent wads, in order to create depth and perspective. The plant spreads through runners, which occasionally have to be trimmed and maybe planted elsewhere.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 长牛毛是一种来自美国的 Eleocharis，呈鲜草绿色，高度可达20-40 厘米。它是一种基本且易于养护的水草。每根草茎只有几毫米粗，植株保持开放的生长形态。它适合作为后景草，也可以种植在水族箱的前景和中景位置，以透明的草丛形式种植，以创造深度和透视感。该水草通过走茎进行繁殖，走茎偶尔需要修剪并可能重新种植。

detail_list.name: Eleocharis parvula
detail_list.introduction: A low-growing Eleocharis that forms runners close to the parent plant. It is prettiest planted in small bunches quite close to each other, which will gradually form a solid mass of plants. An ideal foreground plant, equally suited to large and small aquariums.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 迷你牛毛毡是一种低矮的 Eleocharis，通过走茎靠近母株生长。最好成小束紧密种植，逐渐形成密集的植株群。适合作为前景草，适合大小水族箱。

detail_list.name: Eleocharis pusilla 'Mini'
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Eleocharis pusilla has even lower growth than the common Eleocharis parvula and was given to Tropica by Thomas Barr from USA. Plant the mini-version in small portions to cover a large area. In short time, a dense carpet will be obtained. Needs light to perform optimally, however, it is one of the most reliable species for creating a carpet – and a minimum of maintenance since the leaves remain short (3-5 cm). Suitable for nano-aquariums.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 迷你牛毛毡采用密封杯组织培养。它的株型比常见的迷你牛毛毡更低矮，由美国水草玩家 Thomas Barr 提供给 Tropica。将植株分成小丛并分散栽种，短时间内即可形成致密草坪。充足光照有助于维持低矮株型；叶片仅长约 3-5 厘米，日常修剪较少，适合迷你水族箱。

detail_list.name: Eriocaulon cinereum
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. The genus Eriocaulon is usually adapted to soft water. Eriocaulon cinereum is more tolerant than most and will thrive in medium-hard water. Soft water will promote overall health. This is a quite small, very narrow-leaved and almost cushion-growing plant, that demands good supply of light and CO2 to develop. The plant usually flowers very willingly after planting in the aquarium and the numerous flower stems give a unique appearance. Flowering easily drains the energy of the plant, but given the right conditions, it will gather new energy and grow from basis after some time.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 小谷精草是一种采用密封杯组织培养的水草。该属水草通常适应软水环境，但小谷精草比大多数种类更能耐受中等硬度的水。软水有助于其整体健康。这是一种非常小、叶片非常细窄且几乎呈垫状生长的水草，需要充足的光照和 CO₂供应才能良好发育。该水草通常在水族箱中种植后会频繁开花，众多的花茎赋予其独特的外观。开花会消耗大量能量，但在适宜条件下，它会重新积累能量并在一段时间后从基部开始生长。

detail_list.name: Eriocaulon sp. 'Vietnam'
detail_list.introduction: Eriocaulon sp. 'Vietnam' is a striking aquatic plant with thin, spiky, bright green leaves forming a rosette at the base, resembling pine needles. This plant requires medium light levels and benefits from CO2 supplementation for optimal growth. It thrives in nutrient-rich substrates and soft, slightly acidic water. Regular fertilization and maintenance are essential to prevent nutrient deficiencies and promote healthy growth.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 越南谷精的鲜绿色叶片细长而尖，在基部组成莲座丛，外形近似松针。它需要中等光照，补充 CO₂ 有利于生长；适合富含养分的底床以及偏软、微酸性的水质。定期施肥和日常养护可避免缺素，维持健康生长。

detail_list.name: Fissidens fontanus
detail_list.introduction: This featherlike Fissidens-moss with tight deep green down comes from North America. It grows relatively slow and requires much more light than other mosses. Suitable for attaching to wood pieces or rocks both vertically and horizontally in the aquarium.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 美国凤尾苔是一种羽毛状的凤尾苔，呈紧密的深绿色。原产于北美洲，生长速度较慢，需要比其他苔类更多的光照。适合垂直或水平地附着在水族箱内的沉木或石材上。

detail_list.name: Glossostigma elatinoides
detail_list.introduction: Glossostigma elatinoides from New Zealand is much in demand in Japanese-inspired aquariums. It is one of the smallest aquarium plants (2-3 cm tall), and thus a good foreground plant. A difficult plant demanding a lot of light. Grows upwards if light is poor. Make sure larger plants do not overshadow it. When planting in the aquarium small clumps (approx. 1/8 pot) should be placed at intervals of a few centimetres to help the plants grow together more quickly. CO2 addition and soft water promote growth significantly.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 矮珍珠来自新西兰，深受日式水族箱的青睐。它是最小的水草之一（高度2-3 厘米），因此适合作为前景草。矮珍珠是一种较难养护的水草，需要充足的光照。光照不足时，它会向上生长。确保不要被大型水草遮挡。在水族箱中种植时，应将小丛（约1/8盆）间隔几厘米种植，以促进其更快地生长在一起。添加 CO₂和软水可以显著促进其生长。

detail_list.name: Gratiola viscidula
detail_list.introduction: Gratiola viscidula originates from Northern America and is relatively new to the aquatic hobby. The somewhat ‘thorny’ appearance of the submersed form makes it very distinct and easily recognizable. It is quite easy to grow and prefers good light. By regular trimming it can be kept very low, almost carpeting, but will also present itself well as a fore/mid-ground cushion-plant. Each stem is approximately 1-2 cm wide and can become 10+ cm tall. The stem willingly branches and spreads giving a very dense appearance to the plant.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 黏性水八角原产于北美洲，是水族箱中较新的品种。其水下叶形态略带“棘刺”，使其非常独特且易于识别。它生长较为容易，喜光。通过定期修剪，可以将其保持得很低，几乎形成草坪，但也可以作为前景或中景垫状植物展示良好。每根茎的宽度约为1-2 厘米，高度可达10 厘米以上。茎部容易分枝和蔓延，使植株显得非常密集。

detail_list.name: Helanthium bolivianum 'Quadricostatus'
detail_list.introduction: Echinodorus ‘Quadricostatus’ from South America has characteristic light-green leaves 10-15 cm long which form a good contrast to the darker aquarium plants. It is most beautiful when planted in groups, each roset becoming 15-20 cm wide. In good conditions it produces runners which spread over the bottom. Very light leaves are a sign of a shortage of micro-nutrients. There is some confusion about the name of this plant, and it has been sold as Echinodorus bolivianus var. magdalenensis. Previously known as Echinodorus 'Quadricostatus'.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 四肋皇冠草属 'Quadricostatus' 来自南美洲，其特征是拥有10-15 厘米长的淡绿色叶子，与较暗的水草形成良好的对比。这种水草最适合成群种植，每丛莲座丛可长至15-20 厘米宽。在良好的条件下，它会产生走茎，蔓延至底部。如果叶子变得非常淡，说明缺乏微量元素。关于这种植物的名称存在一些混淆，它曾被误称为 Echinodorus bolivianus var. magdalenensis。此前被称为四肋皇冠草属 'Quadricostatus'。

detail_list.introduction: Helanthium ‘Quadricostatus’ from South America has characteristic light green leaves 10-15 cm long which offer a great contrast to the darker aquarium plants. detail_list.name: Helanthium tenellum 'Green'
detail_list.introduction: Previously named Echinodorus tenellus 'Green'. Previously named Echinodorus tenellus 'Green'.This small rosulate plant will easily make a 5-10 cm high carpet when the light is good and the bottom layer nutritious. Even at an intense light level this variety remains fresh green unlike the usual, more reddish, Helanthium tenellum. An easy and quite undemanding foreground plant.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 针叶皇冠草旧称 Echinodorus tenellus 'Green'。这种小型莲座型水草在光照良好、底床养分充足时，容易形成约 5-10 厘米高的草坪。即使在强光下，这个品种仍会保持鲜绿色，不像普通 Helanthium tenellum 那样偏红。它是容易养护、要求不高的前景草。

detail_list.name: Heteranthera zosterifolia
detail_list.introduction: Heteranthera zosterifolia from South America is an extremely beautiful plant, which forms a lot of side shoots and thus quickly forms a bushy plant group. Stems can become 30-50 cm tall and 6-12 cm wide. Leaves often become black on the back. In strong light growth is intensive, and the plant must be pruned before it becomes so compact that no light reaches the lower leaves. Water roots often form on the stem. Those are easily cut and replanted. In open aquariums, it forms small blue flowers if some shoots are allowed to spread on the surface.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 罗丝草原产南美洲，容易长出侧枝，很快就能形成茂密株丛。茎高约 30-50 厘米，株幅约 6-12 厘米，叶片背面常会变黑。强光下生长旺盛，需要及时修剪，避免下层叶片因遮光而衰弱。茎节经常长出水生根，可剪下枝条重新栽种。开放式水族箱中，若让部分枝条沿水面生长，还可能开出小型蓝花。

detail_list.name: Hottonia palustris
detail_list.introduction: The stem plant Hottonia from Asia and Europe is an unassuming and easy beginner plant. The many curved shoots with fanned and intensely light green leaves quickly create a close group. Each stem becomes 4-6 cm wide and 10-30 cm high. Frequent cutting of the long shoots ensures growth from the bottom of the plant, and maintains the close, bushy form. The plant’s wide form of growth makes it very suitable for the passage between very low and tall plants. The bright green colour creates beautiful contrast and will enhance the shades of surrounding red plants.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 帕鹿雪花草是一种来自亚洲和欧洲的有茎草，适合初学者养殖。它有许多弯曲的枝条，枝条上长有扇形的、鲜亮的浅绿色叶子，能够快速形成紧密的群体。每根枝条可长至4-6 厘米宽，10-30 厘米高。频繁修剪长枝条可以促进底部新枝的生长，保持紧密的灌木状形态。这种草的宽幅生长方式使其适合在高低草之间作为过渡。鲜亮的绿色能够形成对比，增强周围红色水草的色彩。

detail_list.name: Hydrocotyle tripartita
detail_list.introduction: Hydrocotyle sp."Japan" is the popular name of the plant in different plant forums. It is a variant of Hydrocotyle tripartita from South-East Asia. It is characterised by fast, compact growth and small, intense green leaves on vertical stems. The plant is carpet-forming (5-10 cm tall) and its compact growth can be promoted by physically pressing the carpet with your hand when maintaining your aquarium (mechanical retardation). Carpet formation and compact growth do best in good light.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 三裂天胡荽的变种在不同水草论坛中被称为 Hydrocotyle sp."Japan"。这种水草原产于东南亚，以快速紧凑的生长著称，其叶片细小且呈鲜绿色，生长在垂直的茎上。它是一种草坪草，高度在5-10 厘米之间。通过在修剪水族箱时用手轻轻按压草坪，可以促进其紧凑生长（物理抑制）。在充足光照下，草坪的形成和紧凑生长效果最佳。

detail_list.name: Hydrocotyle verticillata
detail_list.introduction: Unlike other Hydrocotyle species, this plant retains its trailing growth form. Verticillata originates from America and becomes 3-7 cm tall. Optimum growth is only achieved in strong light and soft, slightly acidic water. It does not need to be rooted, but can be used as a floating plant. Hydrocotyle verticillata is definitely a foreground plant, but also suitable for garden ponds. If the soil is kept moist, you may even use it as an indoor plant.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 不同于其他 Hydrocotyle 物种，本种水草保持其匍匐生长方式。Verticillata 原产于美洲，高度可达3-7 厘米。最佳生长条件是在强光和软水、微酸性水中。它不需要扎根，也可以作为浮生植物使用。铜钱草绝对是前景草，但同样适合花园池塘。如果保持土壤湿润，甚至可以作为室内植物使用。

detail_list.name: Hygrophila corymbosa
detail_list.introduction: Hygrophila corymbosa is an undemanding starter plant that originates from Asia. In the aquarium it will spread fast and create bright green, long and wide leaves. It is a fast growing plant that must be pruned frequently. New shoots will spread from the stem and make the plant look bushier. The cuttings can be re-planted in the bottom of the aquarium where new roots form quickly. A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. Regarding stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2“). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance into the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant start growing.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 大柳是一种来自亚洲的易于养护的入门级水草。在水族箱中，它会快速生长，形成鲜绿色、长而宽的叶子。它是一种生长迅速的水草，需要经常修剪。新芽会从茎上生长出来，使植株看起来更加茂密。剪下的枝条可以重新种植在水族箱底部，很快就会生根。可以将一束茎或幼苗用锚固定在一起。移除锚后，将植株分开种植。对于有茎草，需要去掉距离底部5 厘米（2 英寸）内的叶子。去除任何受损的叶子。将单株植物间隔一定距离种植在底床上。很快就会生根并开始生长。

detail_list.name: Hygrophila corymbosa 'Compact'
detail_list.introduction: A very compact variety of Hygrophila corymbosa, with the leaves set close to the stalk. Forms numerous side shoots, enhancing the compact appearance. The leaves are a dark brownish-green, when the plant leaves the nursery, but after a transitional period in the aquarium they turn pale green and silver-white on the underside. In strong light, the newest leaves may become reddish brown and in dimmer light, the oldest ones die away after a while. New side shoots often forms to replace the old ones.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 矮柳是一种紧凑的大柳品种，叶片紧贴茎秆生长。该品种侧芽繁多，使其外观更加紧凑。刚离开育苗环境时，叶片呈现深棕色，但在水族箱中经过一段过渡期后，叶片会变成淡绿色，叶背则呈现银白色。在强光下，新生叶片可能会变成红棕色，而在较暗的光线下，老叶会逐渐死亡，但新的侧芽会不断生长以替代旧叶。

detail_list.name: Hygrophila corymbosa 'Siamensis 53B'
detail_list.introduction: Hygrophila corymbosa 'Siamensis 53B' is a variety of Hygrophila corymbosa 'Siamensis'. This Hygrophila 'Siamensis 53B' forms an incredible amount of side shoots and becomes bushy relatively rapidly. Stems becomes 15-40 cm tall and 7-12 cm wide. Its beautiful bright green leaves are narrower than the regular 'Siamensis' and it can achieve red-brown leaves in good light conditions. An undemanding, fast growing plant that requires frequent pruning to maintain a bushy growth. Replant cut-off shoots, they will soon form new roots and grow.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 泰国水蓑衣53B 是大柳 'Siamensis' 的一个变种。这种水蓑衣属 'Siamensis 53B' 侧芽繁多，生长迅速，形成茂密的株型。茎的高度可达15-40 厘米，宽度为7-12 厘米。其鲜绿色叶片比常规的 'Siamensis' 更窄，在良好的光照条件下，叶片可以变成红棕色。这是一种生长快速、养护要求不高的水草，需要经常修剪以维持茂密的生长状态。剪下的枝条可以重新种植，很快会长出新根并继续生长。

detail_list.name: Hygrophila corymbosa 'Stricta'
detail_list.introduction: Hygrophila corymbosa 'Stricta' originates from Thailand and have stems from 15-40 cm and 10-15 cm wide. Leaves are light green and dense. Plant several stems in a group at the background of the aquarium, cut off the top shoots when they reach the water surface and replant these. They will soon form new roots and continue growing. In open aquariums Hygrophila corymbosa 'Stricta' grows easily above the water surface, where it forms blue-green leaves and small blue flowers. It grows fast and the shoots should be pinched out regularly if you want to keep the plant under water. An extremely hardy plant, suitable for beginners.

detail_list.name: Hygrophila costata
detail_list.introduction: This plant originates from South America and stems become 25-60 cm long with 10 cm long leaves. Under water Hygrophila costata has relatively narrow leaves which are grouped close together. Plants sold in the shops are normally cultivated above water, and have rounder leaves with larger gaps between them. Hygrophila costata was called Hygrophila corymbosa 'Angustifolia' until recently.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 肋脉水蓑衣原产南美洲，茎长约 25-60 厘米，叶片长约 10 厘米。水下叶较窄，排列紧密；市售植株通常以水上叶形态培育，叶片较圆，节间也更长。这个品种过去使用 Hygrophila corymbosa 'Angustifolia' 这一名称。

detail_list.name: Hygrophila difformis
detail_list.introduction: Hygrophila difformis from Asia is beautiful and undemanding stem plant. Stems becomes 20-30 cm tall and 6-12 cm wide. A plant for beginners, which will help create balance in the aquarium from the start. Its rapid growth helps prevent algae because the plant absorbs a great number of nutrients from the water. The shortage of micronutrients leads to pale leaves, which may be an indication that the aquarium needs fertiliser. In large aquariums its lobed leaves can create a distinctive group. A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. Regarding stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2“). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance into the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant start growing. (Please notice that bunches/bundled plants are currently NOT produced at Tropica's own nursery. We are unable to guarantee that they are free from harmful pesticides and thus we recommend NOT to put them directly in tanks with shrimps and other delicate fish. Keep bundled plants in tanks where water is changed twice a week for 2 weeks before you add shrimps or fish)
detail_list.introduction_cn: 水罗兰来自亚洲，是一种美丽且易于养护的有茎草。植株高度可达20-30 厘米，宽度为6-12 厘米。适合初学者使用，有助于从一开始就建立水族箱内的平衡。其快速生长有助于防止藻类的滋生，因为它能吸收大量的养分。微量元素不足会导致叶片变淡，这可能是水族箱需要添加液肥的迹象。在大型水族箱中，其裂叶可以形成独特的群体。将一束茎或幼苗用锚固定。移除锚后，将植株分开种植。对于有茎草，应去除底部5 厘米内的叶片。移除任何受损的叶片。将单株植株间隔一定距离种植在底床上。不久后根系将发展，植株开始生长。（请注意，目前 Tropica 自己的组织培养中不生产捆绑植株。我们无法保证它们不含有害农药，因此我们建议不要直接将它们放入装有虾和其他脆弱鱼类的水族箱中。请将捆绑植株先在每周换水两次的水族箱中培养两周后再加入虾或鱼。）

detail_list.name: Hygrophila lancea 'Araguaia'
detail_list.introduction: “Araguaia” is a river system in Brazil and it is under this name that the plant has become known. There are many signs, however, that the plant is a Hygrophila lancea from Japan and Hong Kong. The stem becomes 10-20 cm tall and 6-15 cm wide. It has compact, tight-sitting leaves and grows branches easily. Pinching of the stems maintains a bushy look. The colour is reddish brown to purple, promoted by good growth conditions. The growth rate is average for a Hygrophila.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 阿拉瓜亚是巴西的一条河流系统，该水草就是以这个名字为人所知。然而，有迹象表明，这种水草实际上是来自日本和香港的 Hygrophila lancea。茎的高度可达10-20 厘米，宽度为6-15 厘米。它具有紧凑、紧密排列的叶子，并且容易分枝。修剪茎部可以保持其茂密的形态。在良好的生长条件下，其颜色会呈现红棕色至紫色。生长速度对于水蓑衣属来说属于中等。

detail_list.name: Hygrophila odora
detail_list.introduction: Hygrophila Odora is a vibrant, fast-growing plant that adds a fresh, bright green touch to any aquarium. Known for its bushy, dense foliage, this plant is perfect for aquascapers looking to quickly fill in midground or background spaces with lush greenery. Its rapid growth rate and adaptability make it ideal for beginners and experts alike, providing a natural, thriving appearance with minimal effort. This resilient plant is undemanding, thriving in a variety of water conditions and lighting levels, although moderate lighting will yield the best results. With regular trimming, Hygrophila Odora maintains a compact, bushy shape, making it a versatile addition for any aquascape style. Its fresh green color also provides excellent contrast against red or darker-toned plants, creating depth and visual interest. Key Benefits Vibrant Green Foliage: Adds lush, fresh color. Fast Growth: Quickly fills midground and background. Easy to Maintain: Perfect for beginners and experts. Versatile Planting Options: Great in various aquascape styles. Hardy and Adaptable: Thrives in diverse conditions. Hygrophila Odora is a fantastic choice for aquarists looking for an easy, fast-growing plant that brings life and color to their aquarium, creating a naturally vibrant environment.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 香水蓑衣生长较快，叶片鲜绿，容易形成浓密株丛，适合中景或后景。它对水质和光照的适应范围较广，中等光照即可正常生长。定期修剪可保持紧凑株型，新鲜绿色也能与红色或深色水草形成对比。

detail_list.introduction_cn: Hygrophila Odora 是一种生机勃勃、生长迅速的植物，可为任何水族箱增添新鲜、亮绿色的气息。这种植物以其浓密、茂密的叶子而闻名，适合想要用郁郁葱葱的绿色植物快速填充中景或背景空间的造景玩家。它的快速生长速度和适应性使其成为初学者和专家的合适的选择，以最小的努力提供自然、繁荣的外观。这种适应性强的植物要求不高，在各种水条件和光照水平下都能生长良好，尽管适度的光照会产生最佳效果。通过定期修剪，Hygrophila Odora 保持紧凑、浓密的形状，使其成为任何水族造景风格的多功能补充。其清新的绿色还与红色或深色植物形成鲜明对比，创造深度和视觉趣味。主要特点：鲜艳的绿色叶子：增添郁郁葱葱、清新的色彩。快速增长：快速填充中景和背景。容易养护：适合初学者和专家。多种种植选择：适合各种水族造景风格。耐寒且适应性强：在不同的条件下都能生长良好。Hygrophila Odora 是水草玩家的合适的选择，他们正在寻找一种简单、快速生长的植物，为他们的水族箱带来生机和色彩，创造一个自然鲜艳的环境。

detail_list.name: Hygrophila pinnatifida & moss
detail_list.introduction: Hygrophila pinnatifida and moss on mangrove wood. Hygrophila pinnatifida originates from India. It obtains brown, patched leaves on the surface with a distinctive burgundy colour underneath. It creates horizontal side shoots and the top shoots should be pinched out in order to maintain compact and attractive growth. The horizontal side shoots easily attach to both wood and rocks. Growth is moderate, stems 15-40 cm tall and 10-20 cm wide, and the colour is attractive when planted in small groups with a plain background. Intense lighting ensures compact growth due to the plant's slow to medium growth rate.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 本产品将羽裂水蓑衣与莫丝固定在红树林沉木上。羽裂水蓑衣原产印度，叶面呈带斑纹的棕色，叶背为鲜明的酒红色。摘除顶芽可促使植株长出横向侧枝，保持紧凑株型；侧枝也容易附着在沉木和石材上。它生长速度中等，茎高约 15-40 厘米，株幅约 10-20 厘米。小丛种植并搭配简洁背景时色彩更醒目，较强光照有助于维持紧凑株型。
